remarks: City living at it's best in this conveniently located 3 rd floor condo at Bedford Towers. Whether you're looking to owner occupy or invest, this condo checks all of the boxes. New floors, freshly painted, updated kitchen with subway backsplash, quartz counters, stainless appliances and gas stove! Corner unit offers terrific city views from the living room balcony. 2 generous bedrooms. HOA covers heat, hot water and cooking gas. Easy access to restaurants, library, train station, i-95 and local shopping. This secure -entry building has a spacious lobby area, and offers laundry facilities on the main level, private storage locker and a dedicated on-site superintendent. Private rec. room can be reserved. Don't miss this great opportunity! Seller can help coordinate parking.
